::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Indiranagar) firm offering end-to-end IC design, custom IP and pin-to-pin compatible replacement chips for defence, automotive and industrial customers, plus an ESD-monitoring product. Mix of products and services.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Pin-to-pin compatible ICs, power-gate and custom IP, and ESD-monitoring systems.
